t: If Abhi travels a certain distance at 6 km/h, he reaches his destination 12 minutes early, but if he travels at 4 km/h, he reaches his destination 10 minutes late. The speed (in km/h) at which he should travel to reach his destination on time is:
h: यदि अभि निश्चित दूरी 6 किमी/घंटा की चाल से तय करता है, तो वह अपने गंतव्य पर 12 मिनट पहले पहुँच जाता है, लेकिन यदि वह इसी दूरी को 4 किमी/घंटा की चाल से तय करता है, तो वह अपने गंतव्य पर 10 मिनट की देरी से पहुँचता है। अपने गंतव्य तक सही समय पर पहुँचने के लिए उसे किस चाल (किमी/घंटा में) से दूरी तय करनी चाहिए?

t: A boy travels with speed s km/hr. Travelling with 20% less speed, the boy reaches his destination 40 minutes late and travelling with 4 km/hr more speed, he reaches his destination 20 minutes earlier. Find the value of 's'.
e: Actual speed = s km/hr Let actual time = t hours Then, distance covered = s * t..(i) Travelling with 20% less speed, the boy reached his destination 40 minutes late. So, Distance covered = (100 - 20)% of s * (t + 40/60) = (80/100) * s * (t + 2/3) = (4s/5) * (t + 2/3)..(ii) From (i) and (ii), we have s * t = (4s/5) * (t + 2/3) 15t = 4(3t + 2) 15t = 12t + 8 t = 8/3 And, travelling with 4 km/hr more speed, he reaches his destination 20 minutes earlier. So, Distance covered = (s + 4) * (t - 20/60) = (s + 4) * (8/3 - 1/3) = 7(s + 4)/3..(iii) From (i) and (iii), we have s * (8/3) = 7(s + 4)/3 8s = 7s + 28 s = 28
h: एक लड़का s km/hr की चाल से यात्रा करता है। 20% कम चाल से यात्रा करने पर लड़का 40 मिनट देरी से अपने गंतव्य पर पहुँचता है और 4 km/hr की अधिक चाल से यात्रा करने पर वह 20 मिनट पहले अपने गंतव्य पर पहुँचता है। 's' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A person leaves for his office at 8:45 am everyday and reaches at 9:35 am by driving at 54 km/hr. Today, he left home at the same time but his car broke down at 9:05 am. He took 15 minutes to fix the car and started driving again but at 45 km/hr speed. At what time will he reach his office today?
e:
Time taken by the person to travel to his office everyday = 8:45 am to 9:35 am, i.e., 50 minutes.
Hence, distance travelled from home to office = 54 * (50/60) = 45 km
Today, he drove for 20 minutes at 54 km/hr, so distance travelled for 20 minutes = 54 * (20/60) = 18 km
Distance left to cover = 45 - 18 = 27 km
Also, he took 15 minutes to repair the car, then the time when he restarts the car was 9:20 am.
So, time taken to travel remaining distance = 27/45 = 0.6 hr = 36 minutes
Hence, from 9:20 am, he takes 36 minutes to reach office, i.e., he reaches at 9:56 am.
h: एक व्यक्ति रोजाना 8:45 बजे सुबह अपने कार्यालय के लिए निकलता है और 54 किमी/घंटा की ड्राइविंग करके 9:35 बजे सुबह पहुंचता है। आज वह अपने घर से उसी समय पर निकला परन्तु 9:05 बजे उसकी कार ख़राब हो गयी। कार को ठीक करने में उसे 15 मिनट का समय लगा जिसके बाद उसने 45 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू किया। आज वह किस समय तक अपने कार्यालय पहुंचेगा?

t: Ram drive his car from Varanasi to Lucknow via Allahabad and distance between Allahabad and Lucknow is 8/5 times of the distance between Varanasi and Allahabad. The ratio of average speed of the car from Varanasi to Allahabad and that of from Allahabad to Lucknow is 2: 5. Find average speed from Allahabad to Lucknow if the average speed for the entire journey was 91 km/h?
e:
Let distance between Allahabad and Lucknow be 8x km and Varanasi and Allahabad be 5x km.
Also let the speed between Varanasi and Allahabad be 2y km/h and that of between Allahabad and Lucknow be 5y km/h, respectively.
Total time to travel from Varanasi to Lucknow = 5x/(2y) + 8x/(5y) = 41x/(10y) Hours
Total distance = 8x + 5x = 13x km
According to the question,
13x/(41x/10y) = 91
=> 130y/41 = 91
=> y = 91 * 41/130
=> y = 28.7
Hence, average speed from Allahabad to Lucknow = 5y = 5 * 28.7 = 143.5 km/h
h: राम अपनी कार वाराणसी से इलाहाबाद होते हुए लखनऊ के लिए चलाते हैं और इलाहाबाद और लखनऊ के बीच की दूरी वाराणसी और इलाहाबाद के बीच की दूरी का 8/5 गुना है। वाराणसी से इलाहाबाद और इलाहाबाद से लखनऊ की कार की औसत गति का अनुपात 2:5 है। यदि पूरी यात्रा के लिए औसत गति 91 किमी/घंटा थी, तो इलाहाबाद से लखनऊ की औसत गति ज्ञात कीजिए?

t: A thief takes off on his bike at a certain speed, after seeing a police car at a distance of 250 m. The police car starts chasing the thief and catches him. If the thief runs 1.5 km before being caught and the speed of the police car is 70 km/h, then what is the speed of thief's bike (in km/h)?
e:
Convert 250 m to km: 250 m = 0.25 km.
The thief covers an extra 1.5 km after the police start chasing.
Let the thief's speed be v km/h. Then, his time = 1.5/v hours.
In the same time, the police cover the thief's extra 1.5 km plus the initial 0.25 km head start, total 1.75 km.
Since the police speed is 70 km/h, their time = 1.75/70 hours.
Equate the times: 1.5/v = 1.75/70.
Solve for v:
  v = (1.5 X 70) / 1.75 = 105 / 1.75 = 60 km/h.
Option (b) is the correct answer.
h: एक चोर 250 मीटर की दूरी पर एक पुलिस कार को देखकर एक निश्चित गति से अपनी बाइक पर भाग जाता है। पुलिस कार चोर का पीछा करना शुरू कर देती है और उसे पकड़ लेती है। यदि चोर पकड़े जाने से पहले 1.5 किमी भागता है और पुलिस कार की गति 70 किमी/घंटा है, तो चोर की बाइक की गति (किमी/घंटा में) क्या है?

t: Rohan started a journey from point 'A' at 2:35:20 p.m. and reached point 'B' at 11:18:15 a.m. Kripa started from point 'A' 1 hour 24 mins 40 secs after Rohan and reached point 'B' 41 mins 45 secs after him. How long did Kripa take to complete his journey?
e:
Rohan started a journey from point 'A' at 2:35:20 p.m.
Kripa started from point 'A' 24 mins 40 secs after Rohan
2:35:20 + 1:24:40 = 4:00:00
Rohan reaches point 'B' at 11:18:15 a.m.
Kripa reaches point 'B' 41 mins 45 secs after Rohan.
11:18:15 + 00:41:45 = 12:00:00
Kripa starts the journey from 4:00:00 and completes the journey at 12:00:00 of next day.
Total time taken by Kripa = 8 hours + 12 hours = 20 hours
Kripa takes 20 hours to complete his journey.
h: रोहन ने दोपहर 2:35:20 बजे बिंदु 'A' से यात्रा शुरू की और 11:18:15 बजे बिंदु 'B' पर पहुंचा। कृपा ने रोहन के 1 घंटे 24 मिनट 40 सेकंड बाद बिंदु 'A' से यात्रा शुरू की और उसके 41 मिनट 45 सेकंड बाद बिंदु 'B' पर पहुंचा। कृपा को अपनी यात्रा पूरी करने में कितना समय लगा?

t: Two cars 1350 m apart are travelling in same direction and the faster car overtakes the slower car from behind in 270 seconds. 1350 m apart if they travel towards each other, they will meet after 30 seconds. Find the speed of both the cars (in km/hr).
e:
Let, the speed of faster car is 'a' m/s and the slower car is 'b' m/s.
Time = distance/ speed
According to question,
270 = 1350/ (a - b) [when moving in the same direction, subtract speed]
(a - b) = 5 ....... eq (i)
30 = 1350/ (a + b) [when moving in opposite direction, add speed]
(a + b) = 45 ...... eq (ii)
From eq (i) and eq (ii), we get -
a = 25 m/s = 25 * 18/5 = 90 km/hr
b = 20 m/s = 20 * 18/5 = 72 km/hr
[To convert m/s into km/hr multiply by 18/5]
h: दो कारें 1350 m की दूरी पर हैं और समान दिशा में यात्रा कर रही हैं और तेजी से चल रही कार 270 सेकंड में धीमी चल रही कार से आगे निकल जाती है। यदि 1350 मीटर की दूरी पर वे एक-दूसरे की ओर चलते हैं, तो वे 30 सेकंड के बाद मिलते हैं। दोनों कारों की चाल (किमी/घंटा में) ज्ञात कीजिये।

t: Two trains start from stations A and B, 300 km apart, and travel towards each other at 60 km/h and 90 km/h. They cross and continue to the opposite stations. What is the difference in their arrival times at the opposite ends?
e:
Time taken to meet = 300/(60+90) = 2 h
First train covers (60 X 2 =) 120 km to meeting.
Remaining distance for first train to cover = 300−120 = 180 km
=> time taken = 180/60 = 3 h
=> total time taken = 5 h
Second train covers (90 X 2 =) 180 km to meeting.
Remaining distance for second train to cover = 300−180 = 120 km
=> time taken = 120/90 = 1.333 h = 1 h 20 min
=> total time taken = 3 h 20 min
Required difference = 5 h − 3 h 20 min = 1 h 40 min
h: दो ट्रेनें 300 किलोमीटर की दूरी पर स्थित स्टेशन A और B से शुरू होती हैं और एक दूसरे की ओर 60 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे और 90 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे की गति से यात्रा करती हैं। वे एक दूसरे को पार करती हैं और विपरीत स्टेशनों तक जाती हैं। विपरीत छोर पर उनके आगमन के समय में क्या अंतर है?

t: The speed of a car increases by 2 km/hr after every one hour. If the distance travelled in the first one hour was 35 km, what was the total distance travelled in 12 hours?
e: Distance travelled in the first one hour was 35 km, Distance travelled in 2nd hour = 35 + 2 = 37 km Distance travelled by car in every hour will be in Arithmetic Progression. 35, 37, 39… up to 12 terms First term = a = 35, Common difference = d = 37 – 35 = 2, Number of terms = n = 12 Formula∶ = {2a + [n – 1]d} Total distance travelled in 12 hours = {2 × 35 + [12 – 1]2} = 6[70 + 22] = 6 × 92 = 552 km
h: एक कार की गति हर एक घंटे के बाद 2 किमी/घंटा बढ़ जाती है। यदि पहले एक घंटे में तय की गई दूरी 35 किमी थी, तो 12 घंटे में तय की गई कुल दूरी कितनी थी?
eh: पहले एक घंटे में तय की गई दूरी 35 किमी थी, दूसरे घंटे में तय की गई दूरी = 35 + 2 = 37 किमी हर घंटे में कार द्वारा तय की गई दूरी अंकगणितीय प्रगति में होगी। 35, 37, 39… 12 पदों तक पहला पद = a = 35, सार्व अंतर = d = 37 – 35 = 2, पदों की संख्या = n = 12 सूत्र∶ = {2a + [n – 1]d} 12 घंटे में तय की गई कुल दूरी = {2 × 35 + [12 – 1]2} = 6[70 + 22] = 6 × 92 = 552 किमी

t: A thief steals an item and escapes, running at 20 km/h. A policeman arrives at the spot of the crime after 6 minutes and immediately starts chasing the thief. 24 minutes after the policeman started to chase the thief, there is still a gap of 400 m between the two. At what distance from the spot of crime would the policeman catch up with the thief, and what is the speed at which the policeman ran?
e: Distance travelled by thief in 6 min = 20 * 6/60 = 2 km. Distance travelled in 24 min: 1.6 = (x - 20) * 24/60 => 1.6 = (x - 20) * 2/5 => 8 = 2x - 40 => x = 24 km/hr. Speed of policeman = 24 km/hr. Remaining 400 m can be covered in = 400 / ((24 - 20) * 5/18) = 400 / (4 * 5/18) = T => T = 360 sec = 6 min. Thief total running time = 6 + 24 + 6 = 36 min. Distance travelled by thief in 36 min = 20 * 36/60 = 12 km.
h: एक चोर एक वस्तु चुराता है और 20 किमी/घंटा की गति से भागता है। एक पुलिसकर्मी 6 मिनट के बाद अपराध स्थल पर पहुंचता है और तुरंत चोर का पीछा करना शुरू कर देता है। पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा चोर का पीछा शुरू करने के 24 मिनट बाद भी दोनों के बीच 400 मीटर का अंतर है। अपराध स्थल से कितनी दूरी पर पुलिसकर्मी चोर को पकड़ लेगा और पुलिसकर्मी किस गति से भागा?
eh: जब चोर के बीच का अंतर 400 मीटर था, तब चोर ने कुल कितना समय भागा = 6 + 24. = 30 मिनट चोर द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = 20 × = 100किमी पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा 24 मिनट में तय की गई दूरी =100 किमी - किमी = 9.6 किमी पुलिसकर्मी की गति = = 24 किमी/घंटा सापेक्ष गति =24 - 20 = 4 किमी/घंटा 400 मीटर का अंतर तय करने में लगा समय = = = घंटा = 0.1 × 60 = 6 मिनट पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा चोर को पकड़ने के समय घटनास्थल से कुल दूरी = 20 × = 20 × =12किमी

t: Two trains, one 150 m and the other 100 m long, are traveling towards each other on parallel tracks at speeds of 54 km/h and 36 km/h respectively. How many seconds will they take to completely pass each other?
e:
Length of Train A = 150 m
Length of Train B = 100 m
Total distance to clear = 150 + 100 = 250 m
Speed of Train A = 54 km/h = 54 X (5/18) = 15 m/s
Speed of Train B = 36 km/h = 36 X (5/18) = 10 m/s
Since they move in opposite directions, relative speed = 15 + 10 = 25 m/s
Time to pass = [Total distance] / [Relative speed] = 250 / 25 = 10 seconds
Thus, they take 10 seconds to pass each other completely.
h: दो रेलगाड़ियाँ, जिनमें से एक 150 मीटर और दूसरी 100 मीटर लंबी है, क्रमशः 54 किमी/घंटा और 36 किमी/घंटा की गति से समानांतर पटरियों पर एक दूसरे की ओर यात्रा कर रही हैं। उन्हें एक दूसरे को पूरी तरह से पार करने में कितने सेकंड लगेंगे?

t: Anuj and Anup have to travel from a place A to a place B in their respective cars. Anuj is driving at 70 km/h, and takes 3 halts of 10 minutes each, while Anup is driving at 80 km/h, and takes 4 halts of 15 minutes each. The time taken by Anup to reach Place B, if Anuj takes 8.5 hours, is:
e:
Total time taken by Anuj to reach = 8.5 hours [Including 3 halts of 10 min or total 30 min]
Total time taken by Anuj to reach without halts = 8.5 - 0.5 = 8 hours
Distance travelled by Anuj = Distance travelled by Anup = 70 * 8 = 560 km
Total time taken by Anup to reach without halts = 560/80 = 7 hours
Total time taken by Anup to reach with 4 halts of 15 min each or total 1 hour = 7 + 1 = 8 hours
h: अनुज और अनूप को अपनी-अपनी कारों में एक स्थान A से एक स्थान B तक यात्रा करनी है। अनुज 70 किमी/घंटा की गति से गाड़ी चला रहा है, और 10-10 मिनट के 3 पड़ाव लेता है, जबकि अनूप 80 किमी/घंटा की गति से गाड़ी चला रहा है, और 15-15 मिनट के 4 पड़ाव लेता है। यदि अनुज को स्थान B तक पहुँचने में 8.5 घंटे लगते हैं, तो अनूप को स्थान B तक पहुँचने में कितना समय लगेगा:
eh: अनुज का कुल रुकने का समय = 3 × 10 = 30 मिनट = 0.5 घंटे अनुज द्वारा लिया गया कुल समय = 8.5 कुल ड्राइविंग समय 8.5 - 0.5 = 8 घंटे अनुज द्वारा 8 घंटे में तय की गई कुल दूरी = 8 × 70 = 560 किमी. अनूप का कुल रुकने का समय = 4 × 15 = 60 मिनट = 1 घंटा अनूप द्वारा स्थान B तक पहुँचने में लिया गया समय = = 7 घंटे अनूप द्वारा लिया गया कुल समय = 7 + 1[ठहराव] = 8 घंटे.

t: Anand covers a certain distance in the first lag of 5 hours at the speed of 50 km/h. In the second lag, he increased the speed by 20% due to which he covered 20% extra distance than that of the first lag. He covered the third lag at the average speed of the first two lags and covered 10% extra distance than that of the second lag distance. How much total time (in hours) did he take to complete all three lags?
e:
Total time taken in 1<sup>st</sup> lag = 5 hours
Total distance covered in 2<sup>nd</sup> lag = 120% of 250 = 300 km
Speed in 2<sup>nd</sup> lag = 20% of 50 = 60 km/h
Total time taken in 2<sup>nd</sup> lag = 300/60 = 5 hours
Total distance covered in 3<sup>rd</sup> lag = 110% of 300 = 330 km
Speed in 3<sup>rd</sup> lag = (50 + 60)/2 = 55 km/h
Total time taken in 3<sup>rd</sup> lag = 330/55 = 6 hours
Total time taken to complete all three lags = 5 + 5 + 6 = 16 hours
h: आनंद 5 घंटे के पहले अंतराल में 50 किमी/घंटा की गति से एक निश्चित दूरी तय करता है। दूसरे अंतराल में, उसने गति 20% बढ़ा दी जिसके कारण उसने पहले अंतराल की तुलना में 20% अधिक दूरी तय की। उसने पहले दो अंतरालों की औसत गति से तीसरा अंतराल तय किया और दूसरे अंतराल की दूरी से 10% अधिक दूरी तय की। तीनों अंतरालों को पूरा करने में उसे कुल कितना समय [घंटों में] लगा?
eh: दूरी = 50 × 5 = 250 किमी दूसरे अंतराल में दूरी = 250 + 250 × =300 किमी समय = = 5 घंटे तीसरे अंतराल में दूरी = 300 × = 330 किमी गति = = 55 किमी/घंटा समय = = 6 घंटे कुल समय =5 + 5 + 6 =16 घंटे

t: Anil and Tirath drove between two points A and B 192 km apart. Anil started the journey from point A at 8:20 am. drove at a speed of 64 km/h; reached point B and immediately returned to A at the same speed. Tirath started the journey from point A at 9:50 a.m drove at a speed of 96 km/h reached point B and immediately returned to A at the same speed. e: time taken by Anil to reach B = = 3hr Time taken by Tirath to cover 192 km = = 2 hr Till 11:20 am [in 90 min] the distance covered by Tirath is = 96 × =144 km Remaining distance 192 144 = 48 km And relative speed is 96 + 64 = 160 km/hr Time taken to cover 48 km is × 48 = 18 min So they will meet 18 minutes after 11:20 Actual Time will be 11:20 am + 18minutes = 11: 38am

t: The two trains leave Varanasi for Lucknow at 11:00 a.m. and at 11:30 a.m., respectively and travel at a speed of 110 km/h and 140 km/h, respectively. How many kilometers from Varanasi will both trains meet?
e:
Speed of first train = 110 km/hr
Speed of second train = 140 km/hr
Since trains are travelling in same direction, so relative speed = 140 - 110 = 30 km/hr
Distance covered by first train in (1/2) hr = 110 *(1/2) = 55 km
Time = distance/speed
Time after the departure of second train when both trains will be together = (55/30) hr
Required distance = 140 *(55/30) = 770/3 = 256(2/3) km

t: Saket has his final year exam at XYZ Engineering College. He left his home and travelled at a certain speed so that he would reach the college on time. After travelling half the distance, he realised that he left his admit card at home. He turned back immediately and increased his speed by 50% and reached his home. As compared to his original speed, by what percent should Saket increase his speed so that he still reaches the college on time?
e: Suppose the distance between home and college is 12 km and the speed is 2 kmph. It would take 6 hrs to reach college. When he reaches half way, he has already spent 3 hours. He turns back at a speed of 3 kmph and takes 6/3 = 2 hours to reach home. Now, he has only 1 hour to reach college. So the speed must be 12 kmph. Thus the increase in speed is (12-2)/2 X 100 = 500%.

Ti = 100 m / (5/9 m/s) = 180 s

= 35 X 30 = 1050 m

t: A car and a bus were travelling in the same direction. At 7:30 a.m. the car travelling at a speed of 72 km/h was 4.2 km behind the bus. At 8.15 a.m. the car was 15.8 km ahead of the bus. What is the ratio of the speed of the car to the speed of the bus?
e: Speed of car = 72 km/h Distance covered by car in 1 hour = 72 km Distance covered by car in 45 minutes [from 7 : 30 a.m to 8 : 15 a.m] = 54 km ( × 45) Distance covered by bus in 45 minutes = [54 - 4.2 - 15.8] km = 34 km When time is constant distance is directly proportional to speed: The speed of the car ∶ The Speed of the Bus 54 ∶ 34 27 ∶ 17
h: एक कार और एक बस एक ही दिशा में यात्रा कर रही थीं। सुबह 7:30 बजे 72 किमी/घंटा की गति से यात्रा कर रही कार बस से 4.2 किमी पीछे थी। सुबह 8.15 बजे कार बस से 15.8 किमी आगे थी। कार की गति और बस की गति का अनुपात क्या है?
eh: कार की गति = 72 किमी/घंटा कार द्वारा 1 घंटे में तय की गई दूरी = 72 किमी कार द्वारा 45 मिनट में तय की गई दूरी [सुबह 7:30 बजे से 8:15 बजे तक] = 54 किमी ( × 45) बस द्वारा 45 मिनट में तय की गई दूरी = [54 - 4.2 - 15.8] किमी = 34 किमी जब समय स्थिर होता है तो दूरी सीधे गति के समानुपाती होती है: कार की गति ∶ बस की गति 54 ∶ 34 27 ∶ 17

t: Akshara and Siddharth travel from point P to Q, a distance of 72 km at a rate of 8 km/h and 10 km/h, respectively. Siddharth reaches Q first and returns immediately and meets Akshara at R. Find the distance from P to R.

eh: माना R से Q के बीच की दूरी = x किमी सिद्धार्थ द्वारा तय की गई दूरी =72 + x अक्षरा द्वारा तय की गई दूरी =72 - x उसी समय में सिद्धार्थ ने 10 किमी/घंटा की गति से [72 + x] किमी की दूरी तय की और अक्षरा ने 8 किमी/घंटा की गति से [72 - x] किमी की दूरी तय की = 576 + 8x = 720 -10x 18x = 144 x = 8 P से R की दूरी = 72 – 8 = 64 किमी

t: Dheeraj covers 2/3<sup>th</sup> of distance at the rate of 5km/hr and the rest of the distance at 8km/hr, and manages to cover the overall distance in 7 hours. Find the total distance covered by Dheeraj?

7= ((2/3)D)/5+ ((1/3)D)/8 Or 2D/15 + D/24 = 7
21D/120 = 7 or D = 7 x 120/21 = 40 km

t: Two persons M and N started moving towards each other from their respective homes at the same time. The speed of M is (6/5)<sup>th</sup> of the speed of N. v1 = speed of M

or, t2 = 2.5*36/25 = 3.6 hours

t: A person moved from place A for place B at 2 p.m. at a speed of 4.5 km/h, stayed at place B for 1.5 hours and returned to place A at a speed of 6 km/h. He came back to place A at 7 p.m. What is the distance between places A and B (in km)?
e: A (2 PM) 4.5km/h -> B (1.5 hours stayed) 6km/h -> A (7 PM). Total time in journey 7 PM - 2PM = 5 hours. total effective time in journey = 5 hours - 1.5 rest time = 3.5 hrs. Go Speed 4.5, Return Speed 6. Time 4 : 3 (Total 7). 7 unit = 3.5 => 1 unit = 0.5. Time = 2 hrs : 1.5 hrs. Distance = Speed * Time = 4.5km/h * 2hrs = 9km.

t: Two trains with a speed of 80 km/h and 120 km/h, respectively, are 500 km apart and face each other. Find the distance between them 10 minutes before crossing.
e:
Relative speed of the trains when travelling towards each other = 80 + 120 = 200 km
Time taken when they meet = 500/200 = 2.5 hours = 150 min
Sum of distances travelled by the trains 10 minutes before meeting = 200 * (140/60) = 466.67 km
So, distance between trains 10 minutes before crossing = 500 - 466.67
= 33.33 km

t: How much percentage should a racer increase speed to reduce the time by 20% to cover a fixed distance?
e: We know that: Ratio of time to cover a certain is equal to the ratio of reciprocal of the speeds. Let the actual and decrease time is 100 and 80 respectively. Ratio of actual and increased speed = (1/Actual time): (1/Reduced time) = (1/100): (1/80) = 4: 5 Hence, percent increment in the speed = (5 - 4)/4 * 100 = 25%

t: A boy rides his bicycle with speed 36 km/hr from point A to point B. A girl is riding her bicycle with speed 24 km/hr from point B to point A. If they meet after 2 hrs and the girl takes another 3 hrs to reach point A, then after how much time does the boy reach point B (in hrs)?
e:
Let the distance between A and B be 'd' km and the distance at which they meet be 'n' km from A.
Time taken by boy till they meet = time taken by girl till they meet
So, n = 36 * 2 = 72 km
And (d - n) = 24 * 2 = 48 km
Hence, time taken by boy to cover the remaining distance, i.e., 48 km = 48/36 = 1(1/3) hrs

t: Ram starts from point A at 8 a.m. and reaches point B at 2 p.m. On the same day, Raju starts from point B at 8 a.m. and reaches point A at 6 p.m. on the same day. Both points A and B are separated by only a straight line track. At what time they both meet?

Relative speed = 5 + 3 = 8. Time of meeting = 30/8 = 3 hour 45 min. They will meet at -> 8 am + 3 hour 45 min = 11:45 am.

t: Two stations R and S are 400 km apart from each other. A train leaves from R to S and simultaneously another train leaves from S to R. Both trains meet after 10 hours. If the speed of the first train is 4 km/h more than the second train, then what is the speed of the slower train?
e:
Let the speed of slower and faster train is 's' km/h and 's + 4' km/h.
Relative speed of both the trains when travelling towards each other = s + (s + 4) = (2s + 4) km/h
Distance between both the trains = 400 km
(2s + 4) * 10 = 400
2s + 4 = 40
s = 18
Speed of slower train = s = 18 km/h
h: दो स्टेशन R और S एक दूसरे से 400 km दूर हैं। एक ट्रेन R से S की ओर प्रस्थान करती है और साथ ही दूसरी ट्रेन S से R की ओर प्रस्थान करती है। दोनों ट्रेनें 10 घंटे के बाद मिलती हैं। यदि पहली ट्रेन की चाल दूसरी ट्रेन की चाल की तुलना में 4 km/h अधिक है, तो धीमी ट्रेन की चाल कितनी है?

t: A man covers a total distance of 1560 kms via various modes of transport. He covers one-third distance via train, 220 kms by bus and rest by plane. The train costs him Rs.3 per km and plane costs him Rs.5 per km. If he spent Rs.6364 on his travel, what is the cost per km for travelling by bus:
e:
Distance travelled by train = (1560/3) = 520 kms
Distance travelled by bus = 220 kms
Distance travelled using plane = 1560 - 520 - 220 = 820 kms
Total expenditure on travelling by bus = 6364 - (520 X 3) - (820 X 5) = Rs.704
Cost per km for travelling by bus = 704/220 = Rs.3.20 per km
h: एक व्यक्ति परिवहन के अलग-अलग साधनों के माध्यम से कुल 1560 kms की दूरी तय करता है। वह दूरी का 1/3 भाग ट्रेन से, 220 kms बस से और शेष दूरी हवाई जहाज से तय करता है। ट्रेन से यात्रा का व्यय रु.3 प्रति km और हवाई जहाज से यात्रा का व्यय रु.5 प्रति km है। यदि वह अपनी यात्रा पर रु.6364 व्यय करता है, तो बस से यात्रा करने की प्रति km व्यय कितनी है?

t: Mukul started running from one point towards another point. If he runs at the rate 15/4 km/h, he arrives the destination 12 minutes late. If Mukul traveled at the speed of 9/2 km/h, then he arrives 20 minutes early. What is distance between the two points?
e:
Let original time taken by Mukul to traveled from one point to another point = x hours
According to the question,
15/4 * (x + 12/60) = 9/2 * (x - 20/60)
=> 15x + 3 = 18x - 18 * 1/3
=> 3x = 9
=> x = 3 hours
So, distance between one point and another point = 15/4 * (3 + 1/5) = 12 km

t: A man completed certain journey by a car. If he covered 30% of the distance at a speed of 30 km/hr, 60% distance at 20 km/hr and the remaining distance at 5 km/hr then what was his average speed during the entire journey?
e:
Let the total distance = 100a km
Time taken to cover 30% of distance at 30 km/hr = 30a/30 = a hour
Time taken to cover 60% of distance at 20 km/hr = 60a/20 = 3a hour
Time taken to cover 10% of distance at 5 km/hr = 10a/5 = 2a hour
Hence average speed = 100a/(a+3a+2a) = 16.67 km/hr

t: Two trains A and B both started from station P towards station Q. There are three stops of 10 min each for train A between P and Q and four stops of 15 min each for train B between P and Q. The speeds of train A and B are 60 km/hr and 80 km/hr respectively. Find the time taken by train B to reach station Q, if train A takes 7.5 hours to reach station Q.
e:
Total travelling time of train A = 7.5 hours - (10 min * 3 stops) = 7.5 hours - 30 minutes
= 7 hours
So, distance between station P and Q = 60 * 7 = 420 km
Total time taken by train B to reach Q = (420/80) + (15min * 4 stops)
= (21/4) + 1 hours
= 25/4 hours
= 6 hours 15 minutes
h: दो ट्रेनें A और B दोनों स्टेशन P से स्टेशन Q की ओर चलना शुरू करती हैं। ट्रेन A के लिए P और Q के बीच 10 मिनट प्रत्येक के तीन स्टॉप हैं तथा ट्रेन B के लिए P और Q के बीच 15 मिनट प्रत्येक के चार स्टॉप हैं। ट्रेन A और B की चाल क्रमशः 60 km/hr और 80 km/hr हैं। यदि ट्रेन A को स्टेशन Q तक पहुँचने में 7.5 घंटे लगते हैं, तो ट्रेन B द्वारा स्टेशन Q तक पहुँचने में लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A bus travels at 100 km/h for the first 30 Minutes. Later it travels at 80 km/h. Find the time taken by the bus to travel 290 km.
e:
The distance covered by the bus at 100 km/h in first 1/2 hour = 100 * (1/2) = 50 km
The distance covered by the bus at 80 km/h = 290 - 50 = 240 km
The time taken to covered 240 km at 80 km/h = 240/80 = 3 km/h
So, the time taken by the bus to travel 290 km = 3 + 1/2 = 3.5 hours
h: एक बस पहले 30 मिनट तक 100 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलती है। बाद में यह 80 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलती है। 290 किमी की यात्रा करने में बस द्वारा लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A person's office is 180 km away from his home. To reach his office he travelled one - sixth of the distance at 15 km/hour, half of the distance at 40 km/hour and the remaining distance at 30 km/hour. Find the total time taken by him.
e:
Total distance = 180 km
Time taken to cover one - sixth of the distance
=> 180/(6 * 15) = 2 hours
Time taken to cover half of the distance
=> 180/(2 * 40) = 2.25 hours
Time taken to cover remaining distance = (180 - 30 - 90)/30 = 2 hours
Total time = 2 + 2.25 + 2 = 6.25 hours
h: एक व्यक्ति का कार्यालय उसके घर से 180 किमी दूर है। अपने कार्यालय तक पहुँचने के लिए उसने दूरी का छठा भाग 15 किमी/घंटा की गति से, आधी दूरी 40 किमी/घंटा की गति से तथा शेष दूरी 30 किमी/घंटा की गति से तय की। उसके द्वारा लिया गया कुल समय ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Priyanka travels at the speed of 45 kmph for 5.4 hours and 39 kmph for 7 hours. In this way she covers four-fifths of the distance. At what average speed should she travel to cover the remaining distance in 3 hours?
e:
Let the total distance = X km
She travels the distance = 45*5.4 + 39*7 = 516 km
According to the question, 516 km is four-fifths of the total distance.
Therefore, 4X/5 = 516 km
X = 516*5/4 = 645 km
Remaining distance = 645 - 516 = 129 km
Hence average speed = 129/3 = 43 kmph

t: A bus started running at 12:08 pm in the afternoon at a speed of 160 km/h and it halts for 10 minutes after travelling every 12 km, then at what time it will be 480 km away from starting point?
e:
Halting time = Number of halts * Time taken for each halting = (40 - 1) * 10 = 390 minutes = 6.5 hours

t: X and Y are two stations which are 280 km apart. A train starts at a certain time from X and travels towards Y at 60 km/h. After 2 hours, another train starts from Y and travels towards X at 20 km/h. After how much time from the start of train which left from X, both trains meet?
e:
Distance covered by the train leaving from X in 2 hr = 60 * 2 = 120 km
Remaining distance = 280 - 120 = 160 km
Now, relative speed = 60 + 20 = 80 km/hr
Time in which both trains meet after the train leaving from Y started = 160/80 = 2 hr
Required time = 2 + 2 = 4 hr

t: Charan was initially riding on his motor bike at a speed of 24 kmph. He increased his speed by 3 kmph at the end of every hour. Find his average speed for the first eight hours of journey.
e:
Speed in nth hour = 24 + (n - 1) 3 = (3n + 21) kmph.
Total distance travelled by him in eight hours = 24 + 27 +... + (3(8) + 21)
= 8/2 [2(24) + (8 - 1) 3] = 4(48 + 21) = 276km.
Therefore average speed of Charan = 276/8 = 34.5 kmph.
Hence the correct option is (2).

t: Travelling a distance of 1000 km, a train slowed down due to repairs of the tracks. Its average speed for the trip reduced by 75 km/h and the time of travel increased by 3 hours. The original duration of the travel is:
e: Let original speed = x km/hr. Time = Distance/Speed. 1000/(x-75) - 1000/x = 3. 1000 [ (x - x + 75) / (x(x-75)) ] = 3. 1000 * 75 = 3x(x-75) => x(x-75) = 25000. x(x-75) = 200(200-75) => x = 200 km/hr. Original duration = 1000/200 = 5 Hours.

e: The circumference of the wheel = 2 × × 182 = 1144 cm If the lorry can cover 66 km in 60 min, Then in 1 min the lorry can cover = 1.1 km = 110000 cm Now the wheel of the lorry makes the number of revolutions per min = = 96.15 ~ 96 Approx

t: A policeman noticed a thief from 400 m. The thief started running and the policeman was chasing him. The thief and the policeman ran at the speeds of 14 km/hr and 15 km/hr, respectively. What was the distance between them after 4 minutes?
e:
Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = 15 - 14 = 1 km/hr
Distance between policeman and thief after 4 minutes = 1 x (4/60) km = 1/15 km
Initial distance = 400 m = 2/5 km
Required distance = (2/5) - (1/15) = 5/15 = 1/3 km
h: एक पुलिसकर्मी ने 400 मीटर की दूरी से एक चोर को देखा। चोर भागने लगा और पुलिसकर्मी उसका पीछा कर रहा था। चोर और पुलिसकर्मी क्रमशः 14 km/hr और 15 km/hr की चाल से भागे। 4 मिनट बाद उनके बीच की दूरी कितनी थी?

t: A car covers 20 km in the first quarter of an hour, 25 km in the second quarter of that hour and 15 km in the third quarter. The average speed of the car (in km/h) over the entire journey is:
e: Average speed = Total Distance / Total Time. Total Distance = 20km + 25km + 15km = 60 km. Total Time = 1 quarter + 1 quarter + 1 quarter = 15min + 15min + 15min = 45 min = 45/60 hr = 3/4 hr. Average speed = 60 / (3/4) = 80 km/hr.
h: एक कार एक घंटे के पहले चौथाई भाग में 20 किमी, उसी घंटे के दूसरे चौथाई भाग में 25 किमी और तीसरे चौथाई भाग में 15 किमी की दूरी तय करती है। पूरी यात्रा में कार की औसत गति (किमी/घंटा में) क्या है?

t: Train A takes 35 minutes more than train B to travel a distance of 460 km. Due to engine trouble speed of train B falls by a quarter, so it takes 30 minutes more than train A to complete the same journey. What is the speed of train A (in km/hr)?
e:
Speed ratio of train B = 4: 3
So, the time ratio of train B = 3: 4
Time difference between train A and B = 35 + 30 = 65 minutes
Time taken by train A = 65 * 3 + 35 = 230 min = 23/6 hours
Speed of train A = 460 * 6/23 = 120 km/hr
h: ट्रेन A, 460 km की दूरी तय करने में ट्रेन B से 35 मिनट अधिक समय लेती है। इंजन में खराबी के कारण ट्रेन B की चाल एक-चौथाई कम हो जाती है, इसलिए समान यात्रा पूरी करने में ट्रेन A से 30 मिनट का अधिक समय लेती है। ट्रेन A की चाल (km/hr में) कितनी है?

e: A bus travelling at 75 kmph covers 75/60 i.e. 1.25 km per minute. Now time to cover 50km by 1.25km per minute will be 40 minutes. Therefore, at an average speed of 50kmph, the bus stops for 20 minutes on average every hour.

t: Two trains, P and Q start from stations A and B towards each other. P and Q take 5 hours 20 minutes and 8 hours 20 minutes to reach B and A respectively after they meet. If train P is moving at 55 km/hr, then find the speed of train Q.
e:
Time of P = 5 hours 20 minutes = 16/3 hours
Time of Q = 8 hour 20 minutes = 25/3 hours
Speed of P/Speed of Q = √(Time of Q/ Time of P)
55/ Speed of Q = √[(25/3)/(16/3)]
55/ Speed of Q = 5/4
Speed of Q = 55 * 4/ 5 = 44 km/hr
h: दो रेलगाड़ियाँ, P और Q, स्टेशन A और B से एक दूसरे की ओर चलती हैं। P और Q को मिलने के बाद क्रमशः B और A तक पहुँचने में 5 घंटे 20 मिनट और 8 घंटे 20 मिनट लगते हैं। यदि रेलगाड़ी P 55 किमी/घंटा की गति से चल रही है, तो रेलगाड़ी Q की गति ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A covered a distance of 240 km at a certain speed. Had his speed been 8 km/h less, then the time taken would have been one hour more for covering the same distance. How much time (in hours) will he take to cover a distance of 480 km at his original speed?
e: Distance = 240. Let, original speed = u. reduced speed = (u - 8). Distance = (S1*S2 / S1-S2) * time diff. (u(u-8) / 8) * 1 = 240 => u(u-8) = 240 * 8 => u = 48 km/hr. Time to cover distance of 480 km = 480 / 48 = 10 hrs.
h: A एक निश्चित चाल से 240 किमी की दूरी तय करता है। यदि उसकी चाल 8 किमी/घंटा कम होती, तो उसे उसी दूरी को तय करने में एक घंटा अधिक समय लगता। वह अपनी मूल चाल से 480 किमी की दूरी तय करने में कितना समय (घंटों में) लेगा?

t: Two bullets were fired at a place at an interval of 38 minutes. A person approaching the firing point in his car hears the two sounds at an interval of 36 minutes. The speed of sound is 330m/s. What is the speed of car(in km/hr)?
e:
Distance travelled by the man in 36 minutes is equal to the distance travelled by sound in (38 - 36) = 2 minutes.
Now let the speed of the car be s km/hr.
s x 36/60 = 330 x 18/5 x 2/60
=> s = 66 x 18 x 2/36 = 66 km/h
h: 38 मिनट के अंतराल पर एक स्थान पर दो गोलियाँ चलायी गईं थीं। एक व्यक्ति अपनी कार में निशानेबाज़ी स्थल के पास पहुँचता है और 36 मिनट के अंतराल पर दो ध्वनियाँ सुनता है। ध्वनि की गति 330 मी/सेकंड है। कार की गति (किमी/घंटा में) कितनी है?

t: A thief steals a car at 2:00 am and drives it at a speed of 63 km/hr. The thief is discovered at 3: 00 am and the owner starts the chase with another car at a speed of 84 km/hr. At what time will he catch the thief?
e:
Distance covered by thief in 1 hour = 63 km
Relative speed of owner with respect to thief = 84 - 63 = 21 km/hr
Time taken by owner to catch the thief = 63/21 = 3 hours
Required time = 3: 00 + 3 hours = 6: 00 am
h: एक चोर पूर्वाह्न 2:00 बजे एक कार चुराता है और उसे 63 km/hr की चाल से चलाता है। चोर का पता पूर्वाह्न 3:00 बजे चलता है और मालिक 84 km/hr की चाल से दूसरी कार से उसका पीछा करना शुरू कर देता है। वह चोर को कितने बजे पकड़ लेगा?

eh: मान लीजिए सामान्य गति = xkm/h प्रश्न के अनुसार - = 4 = 4 480x + 4800 - 480x = 4[x2 + 10x] x2 + 10x =1200 x2 + 10x - 1200 = 0 [x+ 40][x - 30]=0 x = 30 और x = -40[संभव नहीं] सामान्य गति x = 30km/h

t: A poster is on top of a building. A person is standing on the ground at a distance of 50 m from the building. The angles of elevation to the top of the poster and bottom of the poster are 45° and 30°, respectively. What is 200% of the height (in m) of the poster?
h: एक इमारत के शीर्ष पर एक पोस्टर लगा है। एक व्यक्ति इमारत से 50 मी. की दूरी पर जमीन पर खड़ा है। पोस्टर के ऊपरी और पोस्टर के निचले सिरे के उन्नयन कोण क्रमशः 45° और 30° है। पोस्टर की ऊँचाई (मी. में) का 200% कितना है?

t: A delivery boy started from his office at 10 a.m. to deliver an article. He rode his scooter at a speed of 32 km/h. He delivered the article and waited for 15 minutes to get the payment. After the payment was made, he reached his office at 11.25 a.m., travelling at a speed of 24 km/h. Find the total distance travelled by the boy.

h: एक डिलीवरी बॉय सुबह 10 बजे अपने ऑफिस से एक सामान डिलीवर करने के लिए निकला। वह 32 किमी/घंटा की गति से स्कूटर चला रहा था। उसने सामान डिलीवर किया और भुगतान प्राप्त करने के लिए 15 मिनट तक इंतजार किया। भुगतान हो जाने के बाद, वह 24 किमी/घंटा की गति से यात्रा करते हुए सुबह 11.25 बजे अपने ऑफिस पहुंचा। लड़के द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
eh: सुबह 10 बजे से 11:25 बजे तक, = 1 घंटा 25 मिनट- 15 मिनट.[प्रतीक्षा समय] कुल समय = 1 घंटा 10 मिनट गति ⟶ 32 : 24=4 : 3 समय ⟶ 3 : 4 7x ⟶ 70 मिनट x=10 मिनट कुल दूरी = गति × समय 32 × +24 × = 16 + 16= 32 किमी

t: Sudhin cycled at 8.5 km/h for 4 hours, then took an auto and travelled at 20 km/h for 1.5 hours, and then walked at 4 km/h for y hours. If Sudhin's overall average speed for the entire journey was 10 km/h, what is the value of y?
e:
Total distance covered = 8.5 * 4 + 20 * 1.5 + 4 * y = 34 + 30 + 4y = (4y + 64) km
Total time taken = 4 + 1.5 + y = (y + 5.5) hours
Average speed = 10 = (4y + 64)/(y + 5.5)
10y + 55 = 4y + 64
6y = 9
y = 1.5
h: सुधिन ने 4 घंटे तक 8.5 km/h की चाल से साइकिल चलाई, फिर एक ऑटो लिया और 1.5 घंटे तक 20km/h की चाल से यात्रा की और फिर y घंटे तक 4 km/h की चाल से पैदल चला। यदि इस पूरी यात्रा के लिए सुधिन की कुल औसत चाल 10 km/h थी, तो y का मान कितना है?

t: Two trains 121m and 99m in length, respectively, are running in opposite directions, one at a speed of 40 km/h and the other at a speed of 32 km/h. In what time will they be completely clear of each other from the moment they meet?
e:
Total length of both the trains = 121 + 99 = 220 m
Relative speed of both the trains when running in opposite directions = 40 + 32 = 72 km/h = 20 m/s
Time taken to cross each other = 220/20
= 11 sec

t: A train with stoppage travels with an average speed of 50km/h. If it stops on an average 20 minutes per hour then find the average speed of the train without stoppage.
e:
Let the average speed of the train without stoppage = s
Required time = 20 min/hour
[(s - 50)/s] * 60 = 20
3s - 150 = s
2s = 150
s = 75
So, the average speed of the train without stoppage = 75 km/h
h: अपने स्टॉप पर रुकते हुए एक ट्रेन 50km/h की औसत चाल से यात्रा करती है। यदि यह औसतन 20 मिनट प्रति घंटा रुकती है, तो स्टॉप पर बिना रुके ट्रेन की औसत चाल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The distance between two stations X and G is 360 km. A passenger express travels from X to G at a speed of 64 km/h, while a goods train travels from G to X at a speed of 86 km/h. What will be the distance between the two trains (in km) 8 minutes before they meet?
e:
A passenger express travels from X to G at a speed of 64 km/h, while a goods train travels from G to X at a speed of 86 km/h.
Distance covered by both train in 8 minutes = (64 + 86) * 8/60 = 20 km
h: दो स्टेशनों X और G के बीच की दूरी 360 km है। एक यात्री एक्सप्रेस 64 km/h की चाल से X से G तक जाती है, जबकि एक मालगाड़ी G से X तक 86 km/h की चाल से यात्रा करती है। मिलने से 8 मिनट पहले दोनों ट्रेनों के बीच की दूरी (km में) कितनी होगी?

t: Akhil takes 30 minutes extra to cover a distance of 150 km if he drives 10 km/h slower than his usual speed. How much time will he take to drive 90 km if he drives 15 km per hour slower than his usual speed?

t: A thief running at 18 kmph, is chased by a policeman whose speed is 20 kmph. If the thief is 125 m ahead of the policeman, the time required for the policeman to catch the thief will be:
e:
Distance between thief and policeman = 125 m
Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = 20 - 18 = 2 kmph = 2 * 5/18 m/sec = 5/9 m/sec
Required time = 125 * 9/5 = 225 sec = 3 min 45 sec
h: 18 kmph की चाल से दौड़ रहे एक चोर का पीछा एक पुलिसकर्मी कर रहा है जिसकी चाल 20 kmph है। यदि चोर, पुलिसकर्मी से 125 m आगे है, तो पुलिसकर्मी को चोर को पकड़ने में कितना समय लगेगा?

t: Distance between two points A and B is 54 km. Arun starts from A at 6 a.m. and travels towards B at 6 km/hr while Brij starts from B at 8 a.m. and travels towards A at 8 km/hr. At what time they will meet?
e:
Distance covered by Arun in 2 hour = 6 * 2 = 12 km
Remaining distance = 54 - 12 = 42 km
Relative speed = 6 + 8 = 14 km/hr
Required time = 42/14 = 3 hours
They will meet at ( 8 + 3) = 11 a.m.
h: दो बिंदुओं A और B के बीच की दूरी 54 km है। अरुण पूर्वाह्न 6 बजे बिंदु A से यात्रा शुरू करता है और 6 km/hr की चाल से B की ओर यात्रा करता है जबकि ब्रिज पूर्वाह्न 8 बजे बिंदु B से यात्रा शुरू करता है और 8 km/hr की चाल से बिंदु A की ओर यात्रा करता है। वे किस समय मिलेंगे?

t: A policeman sees a chain snatcher at a distance of 500 meters. He starts chasing the chain snatcher running at a speed of 5 m/s, while the policeman is chasing him at a speed of 15 m/s. When the chain snatcher is caught by the policeman, what distance will the chain snatcher have covered?
e: Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = 15 - 5 = 10 m/s. Time taken by policeman to catch the thief = 500 / 10 = 50 sec. Distance travelled by thief in 50 sec = 50 * 5 = 250 m.
h: एक पुलिसकर्मी को 500 मीटर की दूरी पर चेन स्नेचर दिखाई देता है। वह 5 मी/सेकंड की चाल से दौड़ रहे चेन स्नेचर का पीछा करना शुरू कर देता है, जबकि पुलिसकर्मी 15 मी/सेकंड की चाल से उसका पीछा कर रहा होता है। जब चेन स्नेचर को पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा पकड़ा जाता है, तब तक चेन स्नेचर कितनी दूरी तय कर चुका होगा?

t: A dog saw a cat at a distance of 280 m. The cat started running at the speed of 10 km/h and the dog also ran to catch it with the speed of 24 km/h. How much time will the dog take to catch the cat?
e: Relative speed of Dog with respect to Cat = 24 - 10 = 14 km/hr = 14 * 5/18 = 35/9 m/s. Time taken by the Dog to catch the Cat = 280 / (35/9) = (280*9)/35 = 72 sec = 1 min 12 sec = 1.2 min.
h: एक कुत्ते ने एक बिल्ली को 280 मी. की दूरी पर देखा। बिल्ली 10 किमी/घंटा की चाल से दौड़ने लगी और कुत्ता भी 24 किमी/घंटा की चाल से उसे पकड़ने के लिए दौड़ा। कुत्ता बिल्ली को पकड़ने में कितना समय लेगा?

t: The angles of elevation of a pole from two points which are 75m and 48m away from its base are α and β, respectively. If α and β are complementary, then the height of the tower is:
e: tan β = h / 48 …(i) tan α = h / 75 (α + β = 90°) tan (90 - β) = h / 75 (α = 90 - β) cot β = h / 75 …(ii) multiply eq. (i) & (ii) tan β × cot β = h / 48 × h / 75 h² = 48 × 75 => h = 60
h: एक खंभे के आधार से 75 मी. और 48 मी. की दूरी पर स्थित दो बिंदुओं से खंभे के उन्नयन कोण क्रमशः α और β हैं। यदि α और β पूरक हैं, तो खंभे की ऊंचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A man runs for 40 km. The time taken by him in the first 10 km is twice the time taken by him in the second 10 km. The time taken in the third 10 km is half of the time taken in the fourth 10 km, and the time taken in the fourth 10 km is equal to the time taken in the first 10 km. If his speed in the first 10 km is 40 km/h, then what is the average speed for 40 km?
h: एक आदमी 40 किमी तक दौड़ता है। पहले 10 किमी में उसके द्वारा लिया गया समय दूसरे 10 किमी में लिए गए समय से दोगुना है। तीसरे 10 किमी में लगने वाला समय चौथे 10 किमी में लगने वाले समय का आधा है, और चौथे 10 किमी में लगने वाला समय पहले 10 किमी में लगने वाले समय के बराबर है। यदि पहले 10 किमी में उसकी गति 40 किमी/घंटा है, तो 40 किमी की औसत गति क्या है?

t: A train goes from P to Q with a speed u km/h, then from Q to R (QR = 2PQ) with a speed 3u km/h, and returns from R to P with a speed u/2 km/h. What is the average speed (in km/h) of the train for the entire journey starting from P and back to P?

t: A man can walk up a moving-up escalator in 24 seconds. The same man can walk down the same moving-up escalator in 48 seconds. How long would it take him to walk up the escalator when it is not moving?
e:
Let speed of esc = a, speed of man = b
Length of esc. = d
⇒ d/(a+b) = 24, d/(a-b) = 48
⇒ (a+b)/(a-b) = 2
⇒ a = 3b
⇒ d/2b = 48 ⟶ d = 96b
⇒ time when esc. not moving = d/b = 96 sec
h: एक आदमी ऊपर की ओर चलती हुई एस्केलेटर पर 24 सेकंड में ऊपर चढ़ सकता है। वही आदमी, उसी ऊपर की ओर चलती हुई एस्केलेटर पर 48 सेकंड में नीचे उतर सकता है। जब एस्केलेटर चल नहीं रही हो, तो उसे उस पर ऊपर चढ़ने में कितना समय लगेगा?
eh:
मान लीजिए एस्केलेटर की गति = a, और आदमी की गति = b है।
एस्केलेटर की लंबाई = d है।
⇒ d/(a+b) = 24, d/(a-b) = 48
⇒ (a+b)/(a-b) = 2
⇒ a = 3b
⇒ d/2b = 48 ⟶ d = 96b
⇒ जब एस्केलेटर नहीं चल रहा हो, तब लगा समय = d/b = 96 सेकंड

t: Bhuvan travels at the speed of 35 km/h by car in 2.4 hours and 12 km/h on foot in 36 minutes. Find his average speed.

t: Riya travelled a total distance of 360 km at an average speed of 60 km/h. She covered the first half of the distance in the first leg in 2 hours. e: Total dist. = 360 km, Total time = 6hr ⇒ s₁ = 180/2 = 90 km/h s₂ = 90/2 = 45 km/h ⇒ d₂ = 45 × 1 = 45 km ⇒ d₃ = 360 - (180 + 45) = 135 km ⇒ s₃ = 135/3 = 45 km/h
h: रिया ने 60 km/h की औसत गति से कुल 360 km की दूरी तय की। उसने दूरी का पहला आधा हिस्सा 2 घंटे में तय किया। दूसरे हिस्से में, उसने पहले हिस्से की गति से आधी गति पर 1 घंटे तक यात्रा की। उसने बची हुई दूरी किस गति (km/h में) से तय की?

t: Two trains P and Q start running from station X to station Y with the speed of 100 km/h and 80 km/h respectively. If train P starts 30 minutes later than train Q from station X and reaches station Y 30 minutes before train Q, then what is the distance between stations X and Y?
e:
Let the distance between stations X and Y = 'd' km
Time taken by train Q - time taken by train P = 30 + 30 = 60 minutes = 1 hour
d/80 - d/100 = 1
d/400 = 1
d = 400 km

t: While travelling from A to B, Rohan covers one-fourth of the total distance at 12 km/h, the next one-fourth at 18 km/h, the third one-fourth at 24 km/h, and the final one-fourth at 36 km/h. On the same route, Suresh travels for one-fourth of the total time of his journey at 12 km/h, the next one-fourth of the time at 18 km/h, the third one-fourth of the time at 24 km/h, and the final one-fourth of the time at 36 km/h. If the overall average speed of Rohan is y km/h and that of Suresh is z km/h, find the value of (z − y).
h: A से B तक यात्रा करते समय, रोहन कुल दूरी का एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 12 km/h की गति से, अगला एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 18 km/h की गति से, तीसरा एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 24 km/h की गति से, और अंतिम एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 36 km/h की गति से तय करता है। उसी रास्ते पर, सुरेश अपनी यात्रा के कुल समय का एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 12 km/h की गति से, समय का अगला एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 18 km/h की गति से, समय का तीसरा एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 24 km/h की गति से, और समय का अंतिम एक-चौथाई हिस्सा 36 km/h की गति से तय करता है। यदि रोहन की कुल औसत गति y km/h है और सुरेश की z km/h है, तो (z − y) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A bus travels a distance of 240 km in 8 hours. The speed of a car is 25% more than that of the bus, and the speed of a bike is 20% more than that of the car. Find the difference between the time (in minutes) taken by the bike and the car to travel a distance that is 50% more than the distance travelled by the bus.
h: एक बस 8 घंटे में 240 km की दूरी तय करती है। एक कार की गति बस की गति से 25% अधिक है, और एक बाइक की गति कार की गति से 20% अधिक है। उस दूरी को तय करने में बाइक और कार द्वारा लिए गए समय (मिनटों में) के बीच का अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए, जो बस द्वारा तय की गई दूरी से 50% अधिक है।

t: A bullet train covers a fixed distance in 30 minutes at an average speed of 240 km/h. Due to track maintenance, it needs to be diverted, increasing the distance by 20%. If the train needs to arrive at its destination on time (i.e., in 30 minutes), what should its new average speed be in km/h?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 280 km/h → ends in 0; (b) 300 km/h → ends in 0; (c) 288 km/h → ends in 8; (d) 320 km/h → ends in 0.
The exact value works out to 288 km/h (see Solution 2), ending in 8 — only option (c) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

Original distance = 240×(30/60) = 120 km
New distance (20% more) = 120×1.2 = 144 km
Since time stays the same (30 min = 0.5 hr): New speed = 144/0.5 = 288 km/h → option (c).
(Shortcut: since time is constant, new speed = old speed × 1.2 = 240×1.2 = 288 km/h directly.)
h: एक बुलेट ट्रेन 240 किमी/घंटा की औसत गति से 30 मिनट में एक निश्चित दूरी तय करती है। ट्रैक रखरखाव के कारण, इसे डायवर्ट करने की आवश्यकता है, जिससे दूरी 20% बढ़ जाती है। यदि ट्रेन को समय पर (यानी, 30 मिनट में) अपने गंतव्य पर पहुंचना है, तो इसकी नई औसत गति किमी/घंटा में क्या होनी चाहिए?

t: A car travels 0.875 km in 1 minute. How far does it travel in 1 hour 45 minutes?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 91.875 km → ends in 1; (b) 94.576 km → ends in 4; (c) 95.444 km → ends in 5; (d) 92.582 km → ends in 2.
The exact value works out to 91.875 km (see Solution 2), ending in 1 — only option (a) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

Time = 1 hour 45 minutes = 105 minutes
Distance = 0.875 × 105 = 91.875 km → option (a).
